**Israel** no longer hides its preference: an agreement between the **United States** and **Iran** over the Strait of **Hormuz** is not necessarily considered a positive development for **Tel Aviv**.  
 This stance was expressed in an unusually clear manner by the Energy Minister of **Israel**, **Eli Cohen**, who stated that from the Israeli side it would be preferable for there to be no agreement with **Tehran**, so that pressure on **Iran** can continue.  
 «From our perspective, it would be better for there to be no agreement. We can continue to exert pressure on **Iran**», **Cohen** told the Israeli **Channel 14**.  
 The statement acquires particular significance as **Washington**, **Tehran**, and **Oman** attempt to find a formula that will allow the safe restart of navigation through the Strait of **Hormuz**.

# Trump eyes victory declaration over Iran without nuclear deal

## According to The Wall Street Journal, the US president is preparing to declare victory if Iran reopens the Strait of Hormuz, even without a nuclear agreement. Tehran, however, is demanding billions of dollars, the withdrawal of US forces from the region and an end to the naval blockade.

![Trump’s Iran dilemma](https://www.israelhayom.com/wp-content/themes/jnews/assets/img/jeg-empty.png "Trump’s Iran dilemma. Photo: EPA, AP")

Trump’s Iran dilemma. Photo: EPA, AP

US President Donald Trump has in recent weeks considered declaring victory in the war with Iran if Tehran fully reopens the Strait of Hormuz, and has privately told senior aides that he is willing to walk away without a nuclear deal, according to US officials cited by *The Wall Street Journal*.

But the prospect of ending the confrontation is becoming increasingly complicated. On Saturday, Iran laid out its most far-reaching demands yet for reopening the strategic waterway. A separate Russian strike on the Saltivka district of Kharkiv killed two people and injured at least 21 more, [according to](https://t.me/s/synegubov) the head of the region’s state administration. Ukraine’s emergency services said firefighters rescued seven people from the upper floors of a high-rise building.

# Taiwan Conducts NBC Decontamination Drill | Han Kuang Exercises Simulate Chemical Attack

## Taiwan’s military has conducted a major nuclear, biological and chemical (NBC) decontamination exercise as part of its ongoing annual Han Kuang military drills. The exercise in Hualien on Taiwan’s east coast simulated a chemical weapons attack involving personnel, tanks and armoured vehicles. Troops practised rapidly moving contaminated vehicles away from danger, identifying contaminated areas, detecting toxic substances and removing hazardous materials. Soldiers wearing full protective equipment also underwent body decontamination, while tanks and armoured vehicles were cleaned and disinfected according to designated procedures. The NBC exercise is one part of the wider Han Kuang military drills, Taiwan’s largest annual military exercises designed to test and strengthen combat readiness against a range of potential threats.
